<div class="section-intro">
This catalogue contains formal scholarly outputs associated with my research. Publication metadata is not maintained manually in the website: it is derived from the research-profile catalogue and synchronized from ORCID and Crossref metadata.
</div>

Conference presentations and posters are maintained separately under [Conferences](/talks/). Scientific software is catalogued under [Software](/software/), while [Data Sources](/data/) is a curated directory of external datasets and services rather than a catalogue of data produced by me.

## Metadata and provenance

The authoritative publication catalogue is maintained in the [`qselmer/qselmer`](https://github.com/qselmer/qselmer) research-profile repository. This website stores a synchronized mirror at `assets/data/publications.json` and generates the formatted list above automatically. The generated fragment must not be edited by hand.
